events.content:
**What happened when generating the panel**

I first checked which evidence layers are structurally usable for dataset IMP01: `discordant_pairs`, `soft_clipped_reads`, `split_reads`, and `read_depth` are all applicable (paired reads and at least one SA tag were observed in the sample).

I then requested an evidence panel for chr20:200000 in IMP01. The tool attempted to build one image per layer, using these windows:

- discordant_pairs: chr20:198,500–201,500 (±1500 bp)
- soft_clipped_reads: chr20:199,850–200,150 (±150 bp)
- split_reads: chr20:198,500–201,500 (±1500 bp)
- read_depth: chr20:197,000–203,000 (±3000 bp)

However, **image generation failed** — every panel entry returned came back with `"error": "IGV not found"` (at least for the discordant_pairs and soft_clipped_reads layers, which is as far as the truncated response showed clearly; the pattern strongly suggests the same failure applied across all layers). This means the underlying IGV rendering tool could not be located/run on this system, so no actual screenshots were produced despite the tool returning image_ref-style scaffolding text.

**Bottom line:** I cannot report on what any image "shows" because no viewable image was actually generated — the panel call failed at the IGV-rendering step for the layers returned. I have no visual evidence to hand off to a reviewer from this call. I also cannot claim any of the four layers' underlying signals (depth drop, clipping pileup, discordant pairs, split reads) without pulling their numeric outputs directly via `read_depth_profile`, `soft_clipped_reads`, `discordant_pairs`, and `split_reads` — I have not done that yet in this conversation.

Additionally, note that chr20:200000 was supplied directly by you and is **not** a position drawn from any registered candidate set — so nothing here confirms it's a real caller-identified junction; it's simply the coordinate you asked me to inspect.

If you'd like, I can pull the actual numeric evidence (depth ratio, soft-clip pileup, discordant pair counts, split-read counts) for this locus via the individual Stage-1 tools, which don't depend on IGV being installed.
